items.period: Received Han Shuowen tradition; SVG created 2015
items.tradition: Small seal script (Shuowen-style modern vector redraw)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of the seal-script form of 給 transmitted in the Shuowen tradition, showing the components later analyzed as 糸 and 合.
items.alt: Black seal-script rendering of 給 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Direct character match and explicit Shuowen seal-style identification; useful for illustrating the received form behind the component account, while clearly not presenting it as an artifact photo.
items.rights: Public domain release stated on the Commons file page; digital vector rendering, not an ancient artifact image.

limitations.text: The proposed image is a modern vector rendering of a received seal-script form. It does not establish an early inscriptional form or a dated graphic evolution sequence.
